AssayDetails: This is an open label pilot study wherein moderate to severely affected melasma subjects Indian females without any skin conditions, off antibiotics or skin lightening treatments will be recruited. Consent would be obtained to complete the study with 10 subjects. Subjects will be recruited in the age range of 20 to 45 years. A series of screening evaluations will be performed in order to determine whether prospective study participants meet the selection criteria for the study.
objectives: Microbial community profiling in melasma lesional and perilesional skin of 10 female volunteers.
